title: Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative) Amendment Bill 2026
short_title: Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative) Amendment Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would add conditions for approving carbon credit methods and change wording used to assess whether those methods satisfy the scheme's integrity standards.
It would require consistency with the Act's objects and public consultation on relevant supporting material, while changing specified tests to refer to possible non-compliance.
The amendments would concern the minister's methodology determinations and the Emissions Reduction Assurance Committee's consideration of proposals within the existing statutory carbon credit scheme.
changes: A ministerial determination would have to align fully with the Act's purposes.
All relevant documentation, modelling and science would have to be available for public consultation.
Specified compliance wording in subsections 106(4B) and 123A(3) would be replaced or expanded to address possible failure to meet integrity standards.
summary.affected: Carbon offset project proponents, the responsible minister and the Emissions Reduction Assurance Committee are affected.
